$comment: Half 1 of a 74HC74 wired as a toggle (D to /Q), with /PRE, /CLR and the clock from pulse sources; half 2 is parked (clock and D low, /PRE and /CLR high).
/PRE is low until 1 ms; the clock rises at 2.5, 7.5, 12.5 and 17.5 ms (1 ms high, 5 ms period); /CLR is low from 10.5 to 11.5 ms. Every edge takes 1 us.
By hand, from the function table (an asynchronous /PRE or /CLR overrides the clock; a rising edge copies D, which is /Q, so Q toggles):

The harness samples at 0, 5, 10 and 20 ms: Q = 1 (set), 0 (toggled), 1 (toggled), 0 (toggled); /CLR's effect falls between samples and test/core/promoted-kinds-fixtures.test.ts reads every interval above on both engines.
